mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte disturbances (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) which increase ranolazine's cardiac toxicity risk and impair its clearance via renal function decline.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (particularly potassium and magnesium), and QTc interval closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible or use lowest effective amphotericin B dose with aggressive hydration and electrolyte repletion.
